scoreRationale: A dispersed rural locality with no independently visitable centre, attraction or visitor-service cluster.

namedTrailSearch.TreasureTrails: The live Aberdeenshire catalogue has no East Cairnbeg product.

practicalAudit.see: The prehistoric enclosure is an archaeological record without verified managed access or interpretation, so it remains a heat pin rather than a See card.
practicalAudit.eat: No café, coffee-and-cake outlet, tearoom, bakery or light-lunch venue was verified inside the strict boundary.
practicalAudit.picnic: No managed public picnic facility was verified.
practicalAudit.parking: No dedicated public visitor parking was verified; private farm and residential access is not parking.
practicalAudit.toilets: No local public toilet was verified and East Cairnbeg is absent from the council directory.
practicalAudit.accessibility: No managed visitor facility publishes accessibility information.
practicalAudit.transport: Dispersed rural locality with no attraction-specific arrival provision.

exclusions: Nearby Fettercairn and Laurencekirk attractions and facilities are outside the boundary.
Private farm access is not a visitor facility.
The NRHE enclosure is not converted into a tourist attraction without managed access.
